title: Replace a built-in theme's colours from the theme studio
description: Takes the JSON the theme studio downloads and writes it over an existing theme's tokens-light.css and tokens-dark.css. Nothing else in the theme's folder is touched — its tailwind-base.css, and anything it declares beyond its tokens, are its own. This replaces a theme; use the studio's zip export to add a new one. Run 'nx sync' afterwards to regenerate the stylesheets and check the result against the token contract.

from.description: Path to the .theme.json downloaded from the theme studio, e.g. ~/Downloads/codeware.theme.json
from.x-prompt: Path to the theme JSON from the studio?
